title: 天原發微·卷四下 (vol 7)
shelf_note: A half-leaf of the Siku Quanshu manuscript copy (block-heart 欽定四庫全書 / 卷四下) of Bao Yunlong's Song-Yuan cosmology with Bao Ning's '寧按' comments. It belongs in the general universallibrary collection. 'published: Unknown' could be filled in (Siku copy, 18th c.).
structure_note: structure.pages_translated is 0, but pages_translated_field is 74 and this page carries a full translation. That looks like a counter defect (E2), not missing translations. Only 9 of 74 pages have a printed number, which fits Siku leaves, where the block-heart folio number is often cropped out of the scan, as it is here. No backsteps or repeats.

pages.layout: single half-leaf of a ruled Siku Quanshu manuscript, vertical columns read right to left: a block-heart strip at the right edge (欽定四庫全書 partly cut off at top, 卷四下), first a column of double-line small commentary (寧按…), then 7 large-character columns

items.quote: Introduction to the Study of the Changes

missing.why: The River Diagram (Hetu) and Luo Writing (Luoshu) are the two numerical diagrams the whole page argues about. A general reader is never told what they are.
Who is quoted is unexplained: Cai Shen (Jiufeng), Zhu Xi's disciple and an authority on the Luoshu numbers.
Nothing tells the reader that 'Ning' is the commentator Bao Ning, whose remarks sit in small type, rather than the author.

missing.english: The number of the substance is ten, and the number of the function is nine
missing.why: 'substance' and 'function' render the technical pair ti/yong. Without a gloss the sentence reads as ordinary English.
'the phases' and the generating/overcoming cycles of the Five Phases are assumed knowledge and are not explained.

book_verdict: Clean page: the transcription matches the leaf character for character, and the translation is faithful, including the tripling arithmetic. The one gloss is correct. The only defects are book-level bookkeeping (pages_translated count 0) and missing orientation notes for a general reader.
